caption:
Cella waters a plant that isn't hers

Cella watered a plant that wasn't hers.

Wilted leaves from thirst often perk up within hours of a good watering, so a droopy plant is rarely as far gone as it looks.

Send it to the friend who waters everyone's plants.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left, looking at a leafy plant on the right that droops sideways. Its eyes go wide, it walks over pushing a watering can along the floor, tips the can and drops of water fall on the plant. The plant slowly lifts upright again, and the figure's eyes turn happy with a pulse.
